frames.name: VK-1B Écuyer Blitz

frames.name: OB-4 Korsak

frames.name: BD-2 Tundra

frames.name: MR-1 Kizuna

frames.name: Technical Refit
frames.special: Either FP-1, M30 or Type-01 Shoulder Cannon. Built from what is to hand: d10 at mission start, on a 1 one weapon is jammed until repaired.

frames.name: AW-3 Lifter
frames.special: Space only. Four arms: one tool attack and a grapple or hold in the same round.

frames.name: HX-7 Kestrel

frames.name: M9 Teamster
frames.special: Quiet running: it cannot be targeted beyond 6 hexes until it attacks.

frames.name: Type-09 Tieshan
frames.special: Protocols: Jam, Power Siphon. Multi-fuel.

frames.name: OB-12 Medved
frames.special: Protocol: Purge. Countermeasure field, radius 2.

frames.name: VK-3 Haubert
frames.special: Protocol: Target Painter. Standard hardpoints: between missions, swap any weapon for another of the same size at no cost.

frames.name: VK-3M Mistral
frames.special: Protocol: Target Painter. Sealed for sand: ignores sand terrain penalties. Standard hardpoints, as the Haubert.

frames.name: BD-5 Caribou
frames.special: Arctic: ignores snow and ice terrain penalties.

frames.name: Type-09I Tieshan-I
frames.special: Multi-fuel. Scheduled spares: repairs and refits cost half as much again, and none arrive after the Sealed Session.

frames.name: QF-2 Haboob
frames.special: Desert feet: ignores sand terrain penalties.

frames.name: AW-5 Rigger
frames.special: Space only. Multi-day shifts: never short of Energy between missions.

frames.name: FK-2 Läufer
frames.special: Shoot and scoot: after its attack it may move 1 hex, unless it charged. Open drawings: repairs and refits between missions cost half.

frames.name: KH-2 Takhi
frames.special: Saddle stores: one extra spare magazine for its rifle. Rattletrap: d10 at mission start, on a 1 it has −1 Move for the mission.

frames.name: Type-99 tank
frames.special: Ground Move only.

frames.name: F-12 Peregrine
frames.special: Flies aircraft paths at LOW and HIGH; carries no spare magazines.

frames.name: HX-11 Harrier
frames.special: Protocol: Ghost Return. PL-2 point-defence laser: explosive ranged attacks against it, or an ally within 2, are −2.

frames.name: HX-9 Osprey
frames.special: Protocol: Ammo Relay. Battery crane: once per round an ally within 1 regains 2 Energy instead of reloading.

frames.name: M12 Bulwark
frames.special: Protocol: Ammo Relay. Two Hornet pods: may fire both as one attack.

frames.name: VK-8 Destrier
frames.special: Tower shield: +1 cover against attacks from its front arc. Multi-fuel.

frames.name: VK-5 Pavise
frames.special: Protocols: Jam, Target Painter, Purge. Countermeasure field, radius 3.

frames.name: CA-3 Falco
frames.special: Hand-built for one named ace: refits cost double, and any other pilot gets none of its Reflex hardware.

frames.name: BD-7 Wolverine
frames.special: Protocol: Ghost Return. Cold hide: while it has not moved this round it cannot be targeted beyond 4 hexes. Arctic.

frames.name: Type-09A Tieshan-Kai
frames.special: Protocol: Sensor Link. Tianshu link: allies on the same link share Target Lock results against a target they can both see.

frames.name: Type-15 Tiebi
frames.special: Dug in: if it did not move this round, +1 cover. Anti-air racks: its Type-03 can target aircraft.

frames.name: OB-17 Mamont
frames.special: Shrugs off rifle fire: hits of 4 damage or less deal none.

frames.name: OB-19 Volk
frames.special: Protocol: Ghost Return. Augmented pilots only: an unaugmented pilot's Reflex counts as 5 in this frame.

frames.name: NK-12 Medved-N
frames.special: Monsoon-sealed: ignores mud and flooding.

frames.name: MX-05 Shiden
frames.special: Protocol: Actuator Lockout. Test mounts: it can carry one prototype weapon from any generation.

frames.name: QF-4 Sirocco
frames.special: Two-bloc mounts: it can carry any medium weapon from any bloc.

frames.name: GL-C Lantern Custom
frames.special: Protocols: Jam, Feed Jam, Overload Spike. No two alike: swap one Protocol for any other from the starter list.

frames.name: CA-5M Ghibli
frames.special: Sensor mast: +1 to Target Lock rolls in open terrain. Multi-fuel.

frames.name: AW-5S Rigger Security
frames.special: Space only. Boarding: after a harpoon hit it can close and attack in the same round.

frames.name: LW-3 Tellus
frames.special: Protocol: Purge. Sealed cockpit: immune to smoke, gas and fallout. Rescue cradle.

frames.name: LW-5 Albedo
frames.special: Firebreak frame: mirror heat shields, dozer blade, trenching cutters, water bladders. Unarmed apart from its hands.

frames.name: FK-5 Querschläger
frames.special: Protocol: Jam. Shoot and scoot. Reformer stack: never short of Energy between missions. Open drawings.

frames.name: KH-5 Bürged
frames.special: Stoop: its Charge reaches Move + 2 instead of Move + 1. Saddle stores and Rattletrap, as the Takhi.

frames.name: HX-X SKYLINE Testbed
frames.special: Protocols: Sensor Link, Ghost Return. Flies HIGH as well as LOW. Beamed power: recharge +4 under the relay, +1 away from it (costed at +3). PL-2 point defence, as the Harrier.

frames.name: M15 Pathfinder
frames.special: Protocol: Power Siphon.

frames.name: CA-X Saetta
frames.special: Built for the Union's top ace.

frames.name: FK-X Aufbruch
frames.special: Protocols: Jam, Ghost Return. Shoot and scoot. Capacitor buffer: the Spiegel costs 1 Energy instead of 2. Reformer stack.

frames.name: KH-X Tsagaan Salkhi
frames.special: Protocols: Sensor Link, Ammo Relay. Shoot and scoot. Stoop. Saddle stores. Never short of Energy between missions.

frames.name: BD-X Polaris
frames.special: Protocols: Sensor Link, Purge. Sealed cab for two with a month of life support. Unarmed apart from its hands.

frames.name: Type-20 Tianyan
frames.special: Protocols: Sensor Link, Target Painter. Commands six uncrewed Tieshans (bought separately, pilot stats 6). If it is destroyed or jammed, they hold and fire at the nearest enemy.

frames.name: OB-21 Tsar
frames.special: Spades: it must spend its move anchoring before firing. Can swap the Kalibr-305 for the Iskra Particle Cannon.

frames.name: OB-X Pamir
frames.special: Fission core: it never runs short of Energy. Each mission the pilot takes a radiation dose.

frames.name: NK-X Ashvin
frames.special: Protocol: Sensor Link. Sworn pair, priced per frame: either may use the other's Target Lock roll.

frames.name: PT-X Raijin
frames.special: Built around one weapon: if the BX-0 is lost, it has only its hands.

frames.name: QF-6 Harmattan
frames.special: Protocol: Purge. Shelter: +2 cover to allies within 1 behind it. Water tank and field medical bay.

frames.name: QT-1 Elissa
frames.special: Shield arm: +1 cover from the front. Evacuation cradle and room in the cab for a medic.

frames.name: AWX-1 Marlinspike
frames.special: Space only. Catapult launch: on the first round it may move twice.

frames.name: LW-X Earthrise
frames.special: Protocols: Purge, Sensor Link. Beamed power: recharge +4 under a Republic relay, +1 away from one (costed at +3). Countermeasure field, radius 3. Rescue capsule for four.
